name: Using Bad Language
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the words we speak reflect the condition of our hearts and have significant spiritual consequences. Taking the Lord's name in vain is expressly forbidden, warning that God will not hold guiltless those who misuse His name. The Proverbs emphasize guarding our speech from perverseness, slander, and deceit, showing that integrity in words is better than wealth with corrupt lips. A righteous person's mouth is described as a source of life, contrasting with the destructive speech of the wicked, underscoring the call for believers to honor God through pure and truthful language.
